review: Independent outcome diagnosis of the first half-filled exclusion-current screen

diagnosis.cause: At E=12, lambda=-12, both nonuniform seeds on both grids fail the independent normalized stationarity gate. The fixed admissibility filter therefore selects the exact flat stationary point on each grid. This creates the 51.54% comparison error and zero profile contrast. The filter follows the frozen plan; the failure is not a wrong sign, factor, physical branch mismatch or new-model result.
diagnosis.selected: N=64 and 128 both select psi=-36 with exactly zero gradient and zero contrast. Zero first variation is not a local-minimum certificate.
diagnosis.stopping_interpretation: SLSQP objective-based ftol termination can occur before the separately normalized KKT residual passes, especially with the stiff short-wavelength grid modes. Agreement of objective values does not authorize relaxing the declared residual. This is an inference strongly supported by the retained rows; no polishing run has yet tested it.
diagnosis.flat_instability: For phi=epsilon cos(2pi x), the quadratic change of the minimized cost is epsilon^2[(2pi)^2+eta^2-E^2]/8 in the continuum, with (2pi)^2 replaced by 4N^2 sin^2(pi/N) on this grid. It is negative at E=12, eta=0. The flat point is therefore unstable in this direction despite its zero KKT residual.
diagnosis.derivative_review: The cost gradient was independently rederived and is correct. The Hessian is (N/2)L plus diag[-E^2 cos(2phi)/(2N)+eta^2 sec^2(phi)(1+3tan^2(phi))/(2N H^2)] minus 2eta^2 outer(w,w)/(N^2 H^3), where w=sec^2(phi)tan(phi), H=mean(sec^2(phi)) and L=2I-periodic shifts. The equality-constraint Hessian is diag[-sin(phi)/N].

physical_evidence_limit.interpretation: The elliptic branch predicts 23.07% and 42.34% complete-group source errors. The other five prediction cases agree with admissible independent profiles to at most 0.0132%. The sixth has close raw values but fails the stationarity gate. This is promising evidence, not a validated gold standard or a passing screen.

narrow_next_diagnostic.proposal: One separately frozen deterministic equality-constrained Newton polishing diagnostic on all 72 retained profiles, with no new seeds/cases or elliptic initialization. Reconstruct phi from the retained density; keep the direct functional, grids, bounds, original acceptance thresholds and group definitions.
narrow_next_diagnostic.limits: At most 12 KKT steps per profile, at most 16 bound-preserving residual line-search halvings per step, target normalized stationarity 1e-8 and fixed least-squares handling of translation null directions. Retain every failed polish and the original report unchanged.
narrow_next_diagnostic.why_not_only_tighter_SLSQP: Changing ftol is less code, but it again controls objective-based stopping rather than directly solving the failed first-order condition. The analytic Hessian is short and already checked, so a fixed KKT polish targets the observed problem without changing the science.
